name: Restaurant Health Inspection Checklist
secondary_keywords: food hygiene rating scheme 5 star audit checklist
search_intent: Restaurant owners, catering directors, and general managers preparing for unannounced local council Environmental Health Officer (EHO) visits, seeking an audit checklist aligned with the 3 official FHRS rating pillars: Hygienic Food Handling, Physical Structural Cleanliness, and Confidence in Management.

competitors.name: High Speed Training
competitors.features: Educational overview of EHO inspection procedures with static PDF download.

competitors.name: Food Standards Agency (FSA)
competitors.features: Statutory guidance explaining scoring criteria without interactive tickboxes.

competitors.name: Virtual College
competitors.features: Training course sales funnel with brief non-interactive bullet points.

competitors.name: SafetyCulture
competitors.features: Generic template requiring proprietary mobile app and account setup.

competitors.name: WebstaurantStore
competitors.features: US-focused FDA food code guide not reflecting UK FHRS 0–5 scoring.

gap_analysis.competitor_weaknesses: Dense government legal prose or static PDFs without digital audit capabilities; lack of real-time scoring across the 3 statutory FHRS pillars.
our_differentiators: Structured directly by the 3 statutory FHRS inspection pillars
Live digital pass/fail/action auditing with temperature probe logs
UK statutory cooking (≥75°C), chilling (≤5°C), and Natasha's Law compliance
Immediate A4 audit report printout for management review
